title: CNCF推动开放主权AI基础设施，OCM进入孵化阶段
english: CNCF announced new members as organizations seek to run AI agents on open, sovereign infrastructure with stronger security, visibility, and control. CoreWeave joined as a Platinum Member to support open source, cloud native infrastructure for production AI at scale. Vultr also became a Platinum Member, emphasizing open interoperability for global AI factory infrastructure. Meanwhile, Open Cluster Management became a CNCF Incubating Project after a Technical Oversight Committee vote. OCM is designed to simplify Kubernetes cluster management across cloud and on-premises environments. Separately, OpenAI highlighted AI adoption in legal services and reported that more than 20,000 veterans and transitioning service members claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus for civilian-career preparation.
chinese: 本轮信号集中在生产级AI基础设施的开放性、主权控制与多集群运营。CNCF新增成员的表述强调：组织希望在开放、主权基础设施上运行AI Agent，并获得更强的安全性、可见性和控制力。CoreWeave与Vultr成为CNCF白金会员，分别关联生产级AI的云原生开源基础设施，以及AI工厂基础设施的开放互操作性。与此同时，OCM经CNCF技术监督委员会投票成为孵化项目，目标是简化跨云、本地环境的Kubernetes集群管理。OpenAI的两项案例则显示，AI正在进入法律业务与职业转型支持场景。
why_it_matters: 对云原生与AIOps团队而言，AI Agent进入生产环境会把多集群治理、安全边界、可观测性和基础设施控制权推到核心位置。OCM的孵化进展值得关注，因为跨云与本地Kubernetes管理是承载分布式AI工作负载的直接运维问题。职业上，资深运维开发可强化Kubernetes多集群管理、平台工程、可观测性及面向AI工作负载的开放互操作能力。
interview_expression: I focus on operating AI workloads with strong security, visibility, and control across cloud and on-premises Kubernetes environments. I see multi-cluster management and open interoperability as important capabilities for production AI platforms.

vocabulary.meaning: 主权基础设施，强调组织对基础设施、数据与运行控制权的掌控。
vocabulary.example: Organizations are looking to run AI agents on open, sovereign infrastructure.

vocabulary.meaning: 互操作性，指不同系统或平台能够协同工作和交换信息的能力。
vocabulary.example: Open interoperability can support AI factory infrastructure at global scale.

vocabulary.meaning: 孵化项目，指进入CNCF孵化阶段的开源项目。
vocabulary.example: Open Cluster Management became a CNCF Incubating Project.
